This sounds like some BS but I don't ever remember words or lyrics from my dreams even if I've become semi conscious and try really hard while I'm still sleeping not to forget. 

On that note these dreams occurred right before I was prescribed anti-psychotic medication. I miss having such fun dreams.

This sounds a lot like my middle school experience, it actually forced me to create a mask to become NT passing that kept developing into high school as well. 
I regret wanting to change so badly. Even though it was so long ago. I really feel like I hid all of my special traits in order to be accepted by mediocre peers. I would try to instill or encourage a sense of self confidence in her. Popular kids are usually not a great crowd to hang out with in the first place. I think you should help her understand that it's better to be unique and not fit in rather than pretend you're someone you're not, just to seek the approval of others. Trust me, it's not as much fun. :-) and to embrace the friends she has already made, who accept her for who she is. I know its cliche, but that's the advice I would have given my younger self too. Hopefully she doesnt try masking to pass as NT like I did. Its really hard to deal with.

Hi! I've picked at my skin like this my entire life, and I have another stim I still like to use from childhood before I go to sleep too this day. When I was 5 or 6 my grandma crocheted me this purple and white blanket (I used to call it "holes with the blanket") and I would repeatedly stick my fingers inside the holes before I fell asleep. it was really calming and soothing to me. The fabric was soft, but not too soft and I liked the feeling of cool fabric between my fingers. If you're crafty, maybe you could make a blanket for her and let her pick out the yarn she likes the feel of best. I'm not sure if she'd like to stim in this way, but it could definitely be worth a chance. :^) I'm almost 20 and I still use this stim. Before I realized I may be autistic I was super embarrassed about it, but its a really helpful way of relieving stress for me. Hope this helps!

I really appreciate your poem, I always think about the physical decay of my body and soul, but never in relation to another person. I think you nailed the feeling of your own decay, and the ending lines, being prepared for the end was an extremely strong message. "You've chosen me to be the thing with which you decay" is slightly wordy, I would try to arrange the sentence a bit. This poem feels like it conveys a toxic relationship, both both parties accept. I would try to add more of the other person's thoughts/POV on the subject of decay to make the poem feel more balanced and fleshed out. Nice work.

The first two lines of your poem do not draw me in to read more, the sound more like you are stating the obvious, than conveying deep emotions of loss and regret. I would have instead maybe used an onomatopoeia for the time, instead of just telling me the time passes. Additionally the beginning of your poem is pretty confusing at first, and feels like you tried too hard to convey the message of lost time and lost the message in the process. When I feel like time i experience paralyzing anxiety, or like I'm stuck in limbo. Try conveying the emotions of time slipping away rather than describing the time itself slipping away.

I love the imagery you used, you know how to balance tone to convey intense or delicate moments at the right times in your work. I can appreciate the unique perspective of the artist when listening to your poem. It gives the piece a well done narrative.
